reviews.title: Absolutely not worth it!
reviews.body: Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.Having just come from ‘The Killer Isn’t Alice’, this was a HUGE letdown. My best friend and I sat down to do it together and had it finished in half an hour. The clues narrowed it too far down from the very beginning and most of our time was counting names in the two chapters it could be (only to realize that one was obviously shorter and we kicked ourselves later, but had we realized it, it would have only taken us 15 minutes). The website was also horrible. No clue clarifications and it ruined who the killer was if you happened to get it wrong the first time. It was a waste of money and trees. Maybe she could re-release it and take like half the clues out to make it better.Read moreRead less

reviews.title: Should have only been two chapters long…
reviews.body: Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.Extremely easy compared to The Killer Isn't Alice (which I thought was fun). One of the clues narrows it to two chapters instantly. Happy I got a refund bc this was very disappointing. It took maybe 20 minutes at most to complete and truthfully I didn’t even have to go through all of the clues, however, their logic as to how they got the killer didn’t make sense (ie it leaves out ‘June’ as a month name in the chapter). The only value I could see in this book is if you HAVENT read The Kiiller Isn’t Alice and wanted to use this as a ‘warm up’ but even then I hesitate to recommend bc of the inaccuracy of the clues.Read moreRead less
